JSON-LD script tag is stripped from output (security) but metadata may be extracted

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<html><head><title>Article</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Article\",\"headline\":\"My Article\",\"author\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Jane Doe\"},\"datePublished\":\"2024-01-15\"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
